description.en: The 75 Ω F-type female port class: a body with an external 3/8-32 UNEF thread that takes a coaxial F connector's coupling nut. A console's RF (antenna) output uses it.
description.es: La clase de puerto F hembra de 75 Ω: un cuerpo con rosca exterior 3/8-32 UNEF que recibe la tuerca de acoplamiento de un conector coaxial F. La salida de RF (antena) de una consola lo usa.
description.fr: La classe d'embase F femelle 75 Ω : un corps à filetage extérieur 3/8-32 UNEF qui reçoit l'écrou d'accouplement d'un connecteur coaxial F. La sortie RF (antenne) d'une console l'utilise.
description.pt: A classe de porta F fêmea de 75 Ω: um corpo com rosca exterior 3/8-32 UNEF que recebe a porca de acoplamento de um conector coaxial F. A saída de RF (antena) de uma consola usa-a.

sources.title: L-com RFPCB-F-FS-1G-86, 75 Ω F female bulkhead-mount PCB connector, customer drawing (rev A, 2023-03-16)
sources.supports: F female port thread 3/8–32 UNEF–2A; 75 Ω; DC–1 GHz (the sheet marks every dimension as reference only)

frame_convention: Origin at the centre of the port's front face, on its axis. +z points out of the port, toward the coupling nut of an F connector; the body and its mounting lie at z < 0. +x is an arbitrary radial reference: the thread is round, so the interface has continuous symmetry.

thread_major_diameter.note: the 3/8 in nominal size of the coupling thread

interfaces.note: Male: the external thread receives an F connector's coupling nut, as the SMA jack's coupling does. Framed on the port's front face.

review_status.note: Drafted in one pass by an agent (console-hyperobjects standard-parts lane, 2026-11-01); facts read from the cited sources on the access date; no language facet has had a native review.

notes: A class entry stating only the shared fact, the coupling thread, as sma-bulkhead-jack does. The SCTE F-port standards (ANSI/SCTE 01 and 02) could not be retrieved, so the centre-conductor acceptance, the reference plane and any D-flat panel cutout are not stated; the one drawing read marks its dimensions as reference only.
